remarks: Welcome to 1019 Concord Street, located within Newport-Mesa Unified School District in the established Mesa North neighborhood of Costa Mesa! This single-story, 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offers approximately 1,287 square feet of living space on a 6,200-square-foot lot. The inviting interior features recessed lighting, smooth ceilings, ceiling fans in everyroom, wall-to-wall stone wood-burning fireplace, and luxury vinyl plank flooring throughout the main living areas. The kitchen showcases white shaker-style cabinetry, a five-burner gas range, stainless steel dishwasher, quartz countertops and farmhouse-style sink, while large windows bring natural light into the living and dining spaces. Additional features include a driveway fitting up to 4 cars and suitable for RV parking. The 2-car garage features direct kitchen access, gas laundry hookups, EV charging, a ceiling fan with a durable epoxy-coated floor. Tropical landscaped front and low maintenance turf back yard. Conveniently located near TeWinkle Park, South Coast Plaza, Metro Pointe, shopping, dining, and major freeways, this home offers comfortable living in a well-established Costa Mesa neighborhood
